title: chat-server: Space/set create drops iconBlobId
description: handle_space_set create (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs build closure) never sets Space.icon_blob_id, so a create carrying iconBlobId succeeds with it silently dropped. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L1332 (6c38e2f) 'Optional: description (String), iconBlobId (String).' Found while fixing JMAP-zmqp, which now rejects unknown create keys but accepts iconBlobId as CLIENT_SETTABLE. Needs type check (Id) plus storing it; RFC 8620 §5.3 blobNotFound may also apply.
